name: furanku-skills
description: Public collection of agent skills; ships the furanku-skills CLI (init, agents-md, guidance-composer)

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.js skills/guidance-composer/test/*.test.js skills/token-speed/scripts/*.test.js && python3 -m pytest skills/crew/scripts skills/model-routing/scripts skills/agent-readable-logs/scripts skills/codemap/scripts skills/usage-drain/scripts skills/token-speed/scripts skills/jam-engine-unreal/adapter/commands/test skills/jam-rig/scripts/test_jamrig.py skills/jam-retopo/scripts/test_topology_report.py skills/jam-uv/scripts/test_uv_scripts.py skills/jam-texture/scripts/test_texture_scripts.py -q
scripts.test:jam-toolkit: npm ci --prefix skills/jam-setup/assets/toolkit --ignore-scripts && npm run typecheck --prefix skills/jam-setup/assets/toolkit && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "skills/jam-setup/assets/toolkit/test/kernel/*.test.ts" "skills/jam-setup/assets/toolkit/test/jam/*.test.ts" "skills/jam-setup/assets/toolkit/test/catalog/*.test.ts" && python3 -m pytest skills/jam-setup/assets/toolkit/test -q
